paragraphs: Welcome to HR Clouds. The Overview section is your command center for managing the organization's workforce. From the Dashboard, you have a bird's-eye view of today's attendance, including who is active, on leave, or absent.

The 'Employees' directory is where you manage user access. You can send invitations to new hires, deactivate ex-employees, and maintain detailed profiles containing emergency contacts, addresses, and organizational designations.
Additionally, the 'Departments' page allows you to structure the company's hierarchy, ensuring that employees are correctly grouped under their respective managers for approval workflows.
Welcome to your Manager Dashboard. This interface is designed to help you monitor your direct reports and manage their daily activities seamlessly.
When you log in, you will instantly see your Team Overview—identifying exactly who is working, who is running late, and who is on leave today.
Your primary responsibility in this portal is to ensure your team's attendance is accurate by promptly addressing their requests and anomalies.
Welcome to your Employee Self-Service Portal! The Dashboard is the very first screen you see and serves as your daily starting point.

Here, you can log your working hours using the large Clock-In and Clock-Out buttons. The dashboard also displays your upcoming shift timings, your current leave balances, and alerts you to any pending requests that require your attention.
Ensure your profile information is up to date, as it is used by HR for payroll and official communications.

hr.intro: The Attendance module is the core of HR Clouds, where you define the global time-tracking rules that govern how employee hours are calculated.
duties: Policies: Define strict rules for late arrivals and early exits. Configure automatic half-day deductions if employees exceed their allowed grace periods.
Shifts & Roster: Create working shifts (e.g., General Shift, Night Shift) and assign them to employees via the Roster. This tells the system what time an employee is expected to be present.

Locations & Geofencing: Define approved office locations. By enabling Geofencing, you can enforce that employees must be physically present within a specific radius of the office to successfully clock in.
Weekly Offs: Configure the standard weekend structures (e.g., 5-day or 6-day work weeks) so the system accurately tracks non-working days.

manager.intro: The Attendance module allows you to monitor if your team is adhering to their assigned shifts and the company's time-tracking policies.
duties: Daily Monitoring: Review detailed punch-in and punch-out logs for every team member to ensure they are completing their required hours.

Anomaly Detection: The system will automatically flag anomalies (such as missing a clock-out punch or arriving extremely late). You are responsible for reviewing these flags and discussing them with your team.

employee.intro: The Attendance module tracks your daily working hours, which directly impacts your payroll. It is critical to log your time accurately.
duties: Clocking In/Out: Always remember to clock in when you start your day and clock out when you finish. Missing a punch will result in an anomaly flag on your record.

Geofencing Compliance: If your company strictly requires office attendance, your mobile device's GPS must verify that you are within the designated office perimeter before the system accepts your punch.
Shift Adherence: Stick to your assigned shift timings. Arriving after the designated grace period will automatically mark you as 'Late' and may result in salary deductions.

paragraphs: The Time Off module manages all non-working days. Under 'Holidays', you can publish the company's annual holiday calendar, which automatically marks all employees as off on those dates.

The 'Comp Off' (Compensatory Off) feature handles scenarios where employees are required to work on a weekend or a public holiday. When approved, the system credits their account with a compensatory leave balance that they can redeem in the future.
As a manager, you are responsible for reviewing 'Comp Off' requests. If you ask a team member to work on a Saturday or a holiday to meet a deadline, they will file a request.
It is your job to verify their effort and approve the request, which subsequently grants them a paid leave balance to use at a later date.
This module helps you keep track of your time off. You can easily view the company's official public holiday calendar to plan your vacations.

If you are ever required to work on a designated holiday or a weekend, you can request a 'Comp Off'. Once your manager approves the request, you will earn a compensatory leave day to use in the future.
The Requests module handles corrections to attendance data. Employees will submit 'Regularization' requests when they miss a punch or face technical issues.

Normally, direct managers handle these approvals. However, as an HR Administrator, you hold ultimate override privileges. If a manager is unavailable or an organizational correction is needed, you can step in to approve or reject any pending request across the company.
Mistakes happen. Your team members might forget to clock out, or their mobile internet might drop. When this occurs, their daily record is flagged as an 'Anomaly'.
Employees will submit 'Regularization' requests explaining the issue (e.g., 'Forgot to clock out, left at 6:30 PM'). You must review these requests and approve them to rectify their attendance logs.
You will also review 'Overtime' requests if employees work beyond their standard shift hours.
Mistakes happen! Did you forget to click 'Clock Out' yesterday? Did your internet disconnect while trying to clock in?

When this happens, the system flags your day with an error. To fix it, navigate to the 'Regularizations' tab and submit a request to your manager explaining the situation. Once they approve it, your record will be corrected.
Lock Periods are the most critical administrative step before processing payroll. A Lock Period completely freezes all historical attendance and request data for a specified date range.

For example, when preparing July's payroll, you will 'Lock' the entire month of July. Once locked, absolutely no one (including managers and admins) can approve late requests, modify shifts, or alter attendance records for that period. This guarantees absolute data integrity for your payroll calculations.
At the end of every month, the HR department will 'Lock' the attendance data to process salaries.

Once a period is locked, the data is frozen permanently. This means you will instantly lose the ability to approve any pending regularization or overtime requests for those dates. It is imperative that you clear your approval queue before HR initiates the monthly lock.
At the end of every month, HR freezes all attendance data to securely calculate salaries. This action is known as a 'Lock Period'.

Once a month is locked, you can no longer submit any requests to fix missed punches or claim overtime for those past dates. Always ensure you resolve your attendance anomalies promptly before the month ends!

The Reports module is your data extraction hub. You can generate comprehensive 'Monthly Attendance Reports' that provide a clean spreadsheet indicating exact present days, absent days, half-days, and overtime hours for every employee.

These exports are explicitly formatted to be ingested by your payroll software. You can also generate highly granular 'Detailed Employee Reports' if you need to perform an audit on a specific individual's historical punch data.
While HR handles official payroll processing, you can leverage the Reports module to track your team's long-term performance and reliability.

Generate customized reports to identify trends, such as team members who are consistently putting in extra hours, or those who are frequently arriving late, empowering you to manage your team proactively.
We believe in complete transparency. You can use the Reports module to view your personal historical attendance logs at any time.
If you ever need to verify that your paycheck accurately reflects the hours you worked, you can instantly generate a report to review your exact punch-in and punch-out records.
